title: The bicycle library
paragraphs: A youth centre started {{1}} bicycle library so that residents could borrow a bicycle for short local journeys. Members registered online before {{2}} received a numbered lock code.

The organisers had worried {{3}} bicycles would be returned late, {{4}} most borrowers followed the schedule carefully. A volunteer checked every bicycle before it was lent out and again {{5}} it was returned.
After three months, the centre used borrowing records to adjust collection times. The service remained small, but it gave families another way to reach the market and bus station.
